sentence_text: Thank you for joining us for the fourth chapter of “An Energy Governance For A Just Energy Transition” Module.
We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.
Module 5 examines energy governance as a catalyst for a just energy transition, highlighting inclusive institutions, legal frameworks, civic engagement, and oversight.

It introduces people-centered, adaptable, digital, and multi-level governance approaches, offering tools and case studies to enhance transparency, policy coherence, and accountability for equitable and sustainable energy transformation.
